**Use case**
Who needs it and why? (e.g. `dsh office docx table` / `dsh ocr vision` / `dsh tiff`)

**Proposal**
Format / provider / UI change. Link a similar `dsh-plugin` or GitHub solution if known.

**Alternatives**
What you do today without it?

**Search**
`dsh attachment` `deepseek-harness plugin` — add keywords so others can find this.
